sign.speaker: Sign
sign.move: Arrow keys or A/D to run. Space to jump; hold it to jump higher.
sign.drop: Hold Down and press Jump to drop through wooden ledges.
sign.wall: Press against a wall while falling to slide, then jump off it.
sign.climb: Two ways up: the stone shaft on the left, or the ledges on the right.

owl.name: Old Owl
owl.hello: Hello, little sprout! Are you really climbing to the top?
owl.ask: Would you like a few tips?
owl.tip1: Stomp on the red mushrooms. Touch them from the side and it hurts.
owl.tip2: Green flags are where you come back when you fall. And grab the gold!

win.title: You made it to the top!
